registration: Frozen before any candidate performance measurements. Candidate was chosen from earlier Headroom decrease-first evidence before inspecting the first comfort-curve results; focused correctness tests may precede freeze.
change: After the existing actor's exact shuffle, stable-sort eligible neighbours by local abs(balance+1)-abs(balance), debt reductions first. Preserve random consumption and within-class shuffled order. Helpers remain eligible. No other actor, settlement, allowance, stream, scoring or policy change.

extension.purpose: Descriptive extension of previously measured graphs; explicitly not held-out validation.
extension.cases: All 12 unchanged original comfort-curve workload cases, preserving their hashes.

heldout.purpose: Fresh prospective validation after fixing the candidate.

inheritance: Reuse frozen comfort_curve_benchmark.run_case unchanged through constructor-only Network injection, restored in finally. Use original plan's graph construction, Poisson RNG, hard grants, no-clearing reference, hard-L1 oracle, time-credit service, actual communication and snapshot-savings definitions. Both methods run underlying comfort_headroom policy; record method separately.

gate.pooled_baseline_requirement: Baseline pooled snapshot_savings must be strictly positive; otherwise gain is inconclusive and promotion fails. Never discard negative savings.
gate.cell_savings_requirement: candidate_savings >= baseline_savings - 0.05*abs(baseline_savings); zero baseline requires candidate>=0. Ratios are null when baseline is zero.
gate.zero_baseline_cost_requirement: candidate cost must also be zero when baseline cost is zero; ratio remains null.
gate.safety_requirement: Every run accepts every offered transaction, has zero blocked or pending work, passes independent settlement/transfer replay, bounds/comfort consent, all-node conservation, service-credit accounting and independent hard-L1 oracle certification.
gate.lower_budget_role: Budget256 is diagnostic only and cannot substitute for a failed high-budget gate.
gate.promotion_scope: A passing gate supports only this tested static/serial and random-arrival research workload, not universal convergence, concurrency, private app implementation or production readiness.

timing: One illustrative sample per run, same warmed imports and fresh network construction as the first curve. Run original and candidate sequentially; alternate method order by case/mode to reduce fixed ordering bias. Communication is primary; runtime gate retained as prospectively requested.
preservation: Never overwrite original source files, original workload or results, or any existing follow-up result. No performance run before the parent authorizes GO and the first comfort-curve campaign is complete.
